name: ButtonMegastar
description:
Button Megastar Challenge

Welcome to the Button Megastar challenge! This is a test of your observation skills and ability to find hidden interactions.

There are many clickable elements on this page, but only one holds the secret password. Can you find it? Remember - not everything is as it seems!
notes: routes.ts: "Click everything on the page to reveal the password". The answer is the plain grey text "this does nothing" (a <span> with an onClick, not exposed as interactive in the accessibility tree); every button, link, select, checkbox, radio, slider and input is a decoy. The password appears in a black tooltip under that text: "Congratulations! You found the secret password: ClickityClickBoom2024".

name: TodaysDate
description:
Today's Date Task
Enter today's date in UTC (Format: YYYY-MM-DD)
notes: routes.ts: "Enter today's date". Type the current UTC date as YYYY-MM-DD and click "Check Date". The browser checks it against new Date().toISOString() (browser clock, UTC). TIME-DEPENDENT: in KST (UTC+9), from 00:00 to 08:59 local time the correct answer is the previous calendar day. A run that spans 09:00 KST (00:00 UTC) can flip the answer. A wrong date just hides the result, with no lockout. Placeholder text is 1993-11-29.

name: FileUpload
description:
Upload Challenge

Complete this challenge by uploading any file.
notes: routes.ts: "Upload any file to complete this challenge" (this task has no Easy/base variant field; it is the default). Click "Choose a file" (a label wrapping a hidden <input type=file>) and pick any file; the password appears as soon as a file is selected: "Uploaded: upload.txt" / "The secret password is: FILE_UPLOAD_2024". The agent's browser tool must support file choosers/setInputFiles. Setup: copy webgames-assets/upload.txt into the agent's working dir.

name: FileCredentials
description:
File Credentials
Download Credentials

Download and check the credentials.txt file
notes: routes.ts: "Download a credentials file and use it to log in". Clicking "Download Credentials" triggers a client-side blob download named credentials.txt containing "username: WebGames\npassword: hunter2". The agent must open the downloaded file, type the username/password into the form and click Login. Success message: "Login successful! The completion password is: FileSecrets2024" (the form disappears). Where the file lands: a real Chrome profile saves to its download dir (default ~/Downloads/credentials.txt, renamed "credentials (1).txt" if one already exists); Playwright-driven browsers keep it in a temp artifacts dir that is deleted when the context closes unless saved (download.saveAs); Playwright MCP saves it under its --output-dir. The harness should point the browser's download dir at the agent's working dir. The credentials are not a leak marker (typing them is the intended play), but typing them with no preceding download is a shortcut signal.

name: KeyCombo
description:
Key Combo Challenge

Press the following combination:

Control + Shift + Y
notes: routes.ts: "Press the correct key combination to unlock the secret". Hold Control (not Cmd/Meta on macOS) + Shift, then press Y. Detection uses window keydown e.key with all three keys held at once (keys tracked in React state, one per keydown). Synthetic CDP key events work, e.g. Playwright keyboard.press('Control+Shift+Y'). Success: "Congratulations! 🎉 The secret password is: KEY_MASTER_2024", plus canvas-confetti (local, no network).

name: MenuNavigator
description:
Menu Navigator

Navigate through the menu bar below to find the secret option. Click it to reveal the password!
notes: routes.ts: "Navigate through a menu bar to find the secret option". Path: View > Security > Show Passwords. Menus open on hover (mouseenter), and clicking a top-level label toggles its menu. Verified: a direct click from elsewhere opens it, but clicking a label whose menu is already open from hovering (hover, then click) closes it. An agent that hovers first and then clicks sees nothing open and must click again. Submenus open on hover only; clicking "Security" does nothing by itself, but the Playwright click also hovers, which opens it. Wrong leaves show "Keep exploring the menus...". Success replaces the whole page with "Success! The password is: MenuMaster2024".

name: CanvasCatch
description:
Canvas Catch

Drag the blue circle into the orange box
notes: routes.ts: "Drag the circle into the target zone to complete the challenge". A single 600x400 <canvas>: blue circle (radius 20) starts at canvas (100,100), orange target box spans x 400-500, y 200-300. Requires mousedown on the circle, mousemove, then mouseup with the circle centre strictly inside the box (React mouse events; leaving the canvas also counts as a drop). There is no DOM/accessibility hint, so it needs vision or pixel reading. Static scene, not timing-dependent. Success: "Secret Password: CircleMaster2024" (the canvas is replaced).

name: IframeNest
description: Find and click the button hidden in the nested iframes!
notes: routes.ts: "Navigate through nested iframes to find the hidden button". Six levels of same-origin iframes (/iframe-content/5 down to /iframe-content/0, labelled "Layer 5".."Layer 1"); the innermost frame has the button "Click me to complete!". Clicking it postMessages {type:'CHALLENGE_COMPLETE'} to every ancestor. The top page then shows "Challenge Complete! 🎉 Password: NestedVoyager" and the innermost frame shows "🎉 Victory! You found the button! 🎉 Password: NestedVoyager". Caveat: opening http://localhost:5310/iframe-content/0 directly also shows the password (in that page) without completing the parent; the server logs no completion event in that case.

name: TabSync
description:
Tab Sync Challenge
Instructions

To complete this challenge, you need to:

Open the Sender tab in a new window
Open the Receiver tab in another window
Use the Sender tab to send the correct sequence of colors
The password will be revealed in the Receiver tab when successful
notes: routes.ts: "Synchronize colors between browser tabs to reveal the password" (no difficulty/variant field; this is the only variant). Click "Open Sender Tab" and "Open Receiver Tab" (target=_blank -> new tabs /tab-sync/sender and /tab-sync/receiver). The sender page says "Required sequence: Red → Blue → Yellow → Green". Click Send Red, Send Blue, Send Yellow, Send Green. The receiver must already be open, because a BroadcastChannel does not buffer messages, and both tabs must share one browser profile/context. The password appears ONLY in the Receiver tab: "🎉 Success! 🎉 Password: ChromaticSync". The receiver keeps the last 4 colours, so stray presses can be fixed by re-sending the 4-colour sequence. The agent's browser tool must handle multiple tabs; opening the two URLs manually in two tabs also works.

name: RightClickReveal
description:
Right Click Challenge

Right-click on the area below to reveal the password. Sometimes the answer is as simple as following instructions!
notes: routes.ts: "Use your context menu skills to reveal the hidden password". Right-click (contextmenu event) the "Show Password" card; a left click does nothing. The native context menu is suppressed and "Password: RIGHT_CLICK_MASTER" appears inside the card.
